about: Machine form of design/VOICE-BIBLE.md sections 3 and 4. The renderer (tools/voice/render_scene.py) reads synth; the direction lint (game/engine/tools/dirlint.mjs) reads never; the portrait reads face. synth values are offsets applied to the source voice (semitones, contour range exponent, rate multiplier, formant scale below 600 Hz and above 1200 Hz). status: rendered = used in the 2026-10-21 prototype (Merrow at the stove), not yet heard by the author; planned = a starting point nobody has listened to.

peoples.gullet: The old families of Gullet: quay, Gut, floor, the Brine. Short vowels, dropped final g, sentences that end low and flat, numbers said as tides and prices.
peoples.kell: The far shore across the open sea: colliers' crews and the Saint Cuthwin's stokehold. A sung, rising contour on statements, kin words (cousin, slack), careful second-language Gullet with full forms (it is, I do not).
peoples.hesk: Up the line: the railhead, the Board's offices, the Shelf, the Trust's money. Clipped, written English said aloud, long Latinate words, no dialect words.
peoples.hill: Chancel Hill: Gullet born, Hesk schooled. The old vowels sanded off; you hear them when the speaker is tired or angry.
peoples.congregation: The Congregation of the Filament: Gullet speech with a liturgy of wiring. Soft onsets, held vowels, technical words said like prayer.
peoples.inner: Lamb's head: no region. Every inner voice is derived from Lamb's own timbre.

NED.timbre: a tired middle voice that says less than it knows; flat at the table, careful at the office
NED.wound: the hill: he went up with Tomas Haldane and there was no hole under the goats

tics: answers a question with the smallest true fact
puts down his fork before he speaks
never_performance: the number he knows is false, said aloud at home
NED.under_stress: fewer words, then none; a pen gets put down hard

range.lying: the same flat voice as the truth, a beat quicker

MARY.timbre: warm, quick, running the table; 'love' and 'go on' as punctuation
MARY.wound: Day 41: she put the heel of the relief loaf on Abel's plate, set Ned's untouched plate in front of Pell, and told the boy there were people up the hill who would kill for it.

answers for other people ('He can't reach')

says the word hunger about anyone she knows

PELL.timbre: a boy's voice, eager, a teacher's words in a child's mouth
PELL.wound: He ate his father's plate fast with his head down and did not look at anybody.
tics: quotes Mr Tamm
says facts about the Hesh he learned at school

ABEL.timbre: a big old voice gone thin at the top, warm, certain, an anecdote always loaded
ABEL.wound: Two summers he had Ilo in the barns, paid him by the sack and was fond of him; at his son's table on day 41 he tells the joke about nine words for rain and none for thank you, and when Ilo's boy is taken he says 'There you are.'
ABEL.lie: I'm fond of them. I'm only saying.
tics: 'I'm only saying'
'That's the thing you have to understand about them'
touches the good hat
never_performance: raises his voice at family; he does not need to
ABEL.under_stress: slower and fonder, which is worse

WILL.role: militia sergeant, the cells and the road post (Brack)
WILL.timbre: a parade voice, chest and throat; orders in two words; drunk, he goes soft and generous and that is the dangerous voice
WILL.wound: the cell: Tomas Haldane died in his cells

counts things aloud (men, carts, sacks)
calls every man 'lad'
never_performance: names the cell as where Tomas died
WILL.under_stress: louder at work, quieter at home; the quiet is the warning

range.grieving: drunk, grateful, telling what he should not
range.lying: a self-lie in his own reasonable voice: 'She bruises easy.'

TOMAS.role: a boy who works the Haldane barns (Haldane)
TOMAS.timbre: a boy's voice, even and polite, trying to sound older; the Hesh rise comes in when he asks
TOMAS.wound: he is the family's wound: arrested for hoarding, dies in Brack's cell
TOMAS.lie: none of his own; the family's lie is told about him ('He went to the hills')
tics: asks once, plainly, and waits
a Heshen word for the hill when he means home
TOMAS.under_stress: slower and more polite, the rise stronger

AARON.role: a boy who walks at the horse's head (Haldane)
AARON.timbre: a small boy's voice, fast and hot, swallowing the ends

ANNI.role: counts the sacks on the cart (Haldane)

READBACK.timbre: one flat, even, unhurried voice reading a typed record into the minutes; no character, no warmth, no irony; the player's own words read in the same flat voice, never imitated

voices.about: Lamb's inner voices (SYSTEMS-FULL 2.1). Every one is LAMB's synth plus the offset here, so they are related by construction. pan is the position inside the head, -1 left to 1 right; depth 0 at the ear to 1 at the centre of the head.

instruments.about: The Kit are objects. Designed timbres: Lamb's source voice through a resonator built for each object, so no person's likeness is involved. Placed outside the head, in the case at Lamb's hip.

setting_note: Speakers marked setting gullet belong to the cut first setting (QUOTA-DESIGN decision 3); setting quota is the current game.

peoples_quota.tarn-town: The Upper Town's Tarn: clerks, inspectors, merchants. Finished consonants, a level tune, sentences that close on the verb; Directorate words at work and plain words at home.
peoples_quota.tarn-plain: The plain's Tarn: farmers, cottars, the militia's men. Dropped final g, 'you've not' and 'I'll not', short sentences that fall at the end; field, weather and sack words.
peoples_quota.hesh: The Hesh, Heshen first: a rise at the end of a statement that a Tarn ear hears as a question; Tarnish learned in the barns, full forms ('I do not'); Heshen words for water, rain, the Well and kin when the speaker is moved or afraid.
peoples_quota.half-hesh: Raised in the Upper Town by a Hesh father and a Tarn mother: Tarnish first, the Hesh rise only under stress, Heshen words only at home.
peoples_quota.directorate: The People's Directorate's officers: written Arlen said aloud: passives, figures, titles, the word 'comrade' used as a stop.

slurs.about: The invented slurs of 01-WORLD.md. Spoken in full by a character with a history and someone who hears it; never by the narrator, the interface or the read-back's own voice (VOICE-BIBLE 11.5).

readback.speaker: READBACK
readback.about: The read-back's flat voice (VOICE-BIBLE 11.4): one voice, flat, no stress, no breath, no room, no music; the dirlint holds READBACK lines to it.
